findings.observation: The committed documentation cleanup inventory is not reproducible from the current source tree.
findings.expected: The owner command exits 0 and both generated inventory artifacts match the current documentation tree.
findings.actual: The owner command exits 1 and reports mismatches in documentation-cleanup-inventory.json and documentation-cleanup-inventory.md; the canonical docs verify command stops at the same check.
findings.impact: The canonical documentation verification gate is red and contributors cannot distinguish intended documentation changes from stale generated evidence.
findings.root_cause: The generated inventory was not refreshed after documentation source changes.
findings.remediation: Run the canonical owner update command and commit only the reproducible generated delta.
findings.automation: Existing generated-artifact check; keep it green in the docs CI path.

findings.observation: The strict documentation build and the canonical relative-link check both allow links to missing Markdown anchors.
findings.expected: A link to a heading that does not exist fails the canonical documentation gate.
findings.actual: mkdocs build --strict exits 0 while 35 missing-anchor diagnostics remain below warning severity; check-links also exits 0 because it validates target files but not generic fragments. Examples include docs/02-architecture/domain/aggregate-invariants.md:51 and docs/04-reference/providers/crossref/publication.md:114.
findings.impact: Published navigation can lead to the top of a page instead of the promised section while all required documentation checks remain green.

evidence.observation: validation.links.not_found is downgraded, anchors has no strict-build warning override, and the build exits 0 with 35 missing-anchor diagnostics.
The link targets #batch-aggregate, which is absent from docs/04-reference/domain/invariants.md.
The same-page link targets #internalextended-material, but that heading is absent from the page.

findings.root_cause: MkDocs anchor validation remains below warning severity and the custom link checker does not parse and resolve Markdown fragments.
findings.remediation: Raise missing-anchor validation to warning for strict builds, repair the proven broken anchors, and lock the configuration with a regression test.
findings.automation: MkDocs strict anchor severity plus an architecture regression test.
